title: Agent Quest now tells you when Claude Code or Codex needs you visually and with sound
body: A few weeks ago I shared Agent Quest , my open-source experiment that turns Claude Code and Codex sessions into heroes living inside a small 2D world. The original idea was mainly about making it easier to understand what multiple agents were doing in real time. Since then, I’ve been working on making it actually useful as a monitoring tool.
